scope: Two downloaded supplemental municipal PDFs and their city-quarter map/context pages; this is not an exhaustive search of all possible Kaposvár sources.

spellingPolicy: These comparison labels preserve existing full source-unit identities; map abbreviations, hyphens and Fészerlak/Fészerlakpuszta variants remain source variants, not new canonical-name decisions.

nativeGeometry.pixelContourExtractionDisposition: The ten source-unit outlines are useful map evidence but duplicating existing units would not add a new fine quarter. Neither map draws finer internal divisions within compound units.
nativeGeometry.uncertaintyExplanation: No geographic polygon was emitted and no geographic transform was fitted. Raster source outlines have no established geographic projection or accepted physical control correspondence in this packet. Null is unknown, not zero error.

identityEvidence.finding: The document lists ten functional IVS quarters; its city map numbers the same ten units. Six compound labels remain undivided.

The whole Belváros quarter contains the smaller Városközpont intervention area. Page 44 identifies the 13.85 ha intervention area explicitly, so its later closed maps and street-number list do not establish a whole-quarter contour.
